notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Hi everybody! A new update with new content and bug fixes.

Changes:

1. New level: Misty Caverns. It is an ominous bottomless pit with dangerous platforms and cliffs.
2. A more appealing User Interface theme and it adapts better to different aspect ratios.
3. Shadows are disabled by default: increases performance, but you can toggle it on if desired.
4. Limited shadow distance: increases performance.

Bug fixes:

1. Progress bar: displays the correct percentage.
2. Grass and decals materials: rendered in the correct order.
3. Menus load faster now.

More to come, see you soon!

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Hello everybody! This update focused on adding Settings options and the requested Keybindings menu.

Changes:

1. Settings: Look Sensitivity
2. Settings: Invert Camera Y Axis
3. Settings: Switch Camera Look to Left Thumbstick
4. Keybindings: now you can customize Keyboard/Mouse and Gamepad controls to your liking
5. Content: desert snake added to the Drylands

Some small bug fixes in menus and in some game entities.
Now I believe I can finally return to content creation: new areas, enemies and guns.

See you soon!
Leocesar3D, Human Diaspora’s solo developer

notes.title: Update 4 (small)
notes.content: Hi everyone! Time again for another small update. Small, yes! But it brings better game performance all around. I heard some complaints about game freezing for short periods of time, or substantial frame rate drops to the point of making the game experience just plain bad. Now I found some code culprits and made them take the long walk towards oblivion. I tested it out for over a week and I say that the game run smoother on all levels. But here and there, there are some small frame rate drops but nothing serious. It occurs mostly when there is a lot going on, like several enemies fighting at the same time. Took the time also to tweak some game settings and behaviors for the dynamic objects in all the game. Well, now is finally time to get back to create more levels, enemies, or even new game mechanics. My goal is to make Human Diaspora a game that has a whole lot of non-stop action. See you soon!

notes.title: Update 3 (minor)
notes.content:
Hi Folks! This is a quality of life minor update that fixes some issues encountered by you and reported to me through the Steam platform.

[b]Changes:[/b]

1. Added a Level Selector: for those that didn’t like the strategy mode, you can skip it all together, and play whatever level you liked the most. Bear in mind that there is no game progression in this mode. You play the level, beat it or not, but it has no effect on the game as a whole. Not just that. When I add new levels you can play it first hand without fuss.

2. Minor adjustments in enemy damage, Sound FX volume and game settings.

[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]

1. Now you can use both the controller and keyboard/mouse, no more locked cursor. You can connect, at any time, the controller and the game should recognize it immediately.

See you soon.
Leocesar3D

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Hello everybody! It is time for the second regular update for Human Diaspora. This update brings new content and overall bug fixes. You may need to play a new game to see the changes. Please don’t forget to share with me your good or bad experience with the game! Only this way I can improve it over time. 

[b]Changes:[/b]

1. I added two vehicles: space fighter and tank.
2. New level: Deep Space Pirates. Take control of a space fighter, prepare for fierce dogfights!
3. New level: Drylands. Control a mounted turret tank in the arid lands of the Planet.
4. New level: Floating Arena. This level is very hard and requires a lot of practice to beat it.
5. Updated the Seabed underwater base with more visual/audio details.
6. New enemies: tank and space fighter

[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]

1. Soundtrack abruptly starting on game launch.

[b]Known issues:[/b]

1. My controller doesn’t work, the cursor is locked on the screen: turn on the controller and restart the game. It should be recognized.
2. Random missing texture: this is a Game Engine problem and I didn’t find a solution yet.
3. Game freezes momentarily/hiccups: mostly the game loading level sections. It goes away while playing.

See you soon in the next update!
Current game version: 2020.09.G

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is the first regular update I made for Human Diaspora, it fixes some important issues with the release build, so test it out. Tell me if you experienced something that you didn’t like about the game. It’s through your feedback that I’ll be able to create a better gaming experience for everyone. Thank you to support me in my game dev journey!

Changes:

1. Settings/Controls menu: Added video, difficulty and audio adjustments, now you can adjust the game for better performance, easier/harder challenge and tone down or disable music/sound effects completely. Be aware that changing some settings may affect performance reducing the FPS rate. This change overrides the old settings file, so go to the settings menu to save your new values. It may not affect game progress.
2. Added an underwater base in Methane sea: where the explosive device may spawn inside, but I will upgrade it in future updates.
3. Minor visual tweaks.

Bugs:

1. Bombardment rules and button now function as expected.
2. Death bug removed: the player dies no more after winning a battle in FPS mode.
3. Resources didn’t update correctly to both player and computer, leading to wrong values.
4. Player footsteps Sound Effect continued playing after a full stop.
